title: 不 / 没 — negation
explanation: 不 negates present/future actions and adjectives. 没 negates past actions and possession (没 + 有). 不 changes to second tone (bú) before a fourth-tone syllable.
structure: Subj + 不/没 + Verb/Adj  |  Subj + 没 + 有 + Noun

examples.pinyin: wǒ méi kàn nà běn shū

notes: 不 + 4th tone → bú (e.g., 不是 bú shì). 没 is for completed/realized actions and with 有. 不 is for habitual, future, and adjectives.
